parameters.help_en: The stable ID of the target knowledge base. You can obtain this ID by calling ListKnowledgeBases
parameters.help_zh: 目标知识库的稳定 ID，可通过 ListKnowledgeBases 获取
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the knowledge point. Valid values: GRAPH for local graph entry, WIKI for Wiki page, and KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT for knowledge content. If this parameter is omitted, all types are listed
parameters.help_zh: 知识点类型：GRAPH 为局部图入口，WIKI 为 Wiki 页面，KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT 为知识内容。省略时列出全部类型
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of knowledge points to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的知识点数量，取值 1～100，省略时为 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Do not specify this parameter for the first page. For subsequent pages, pass the NextToken value from the previous response as is, and keep the knowledge base, type, and page size unchanged. An empty cursor indicates the end of the list. If the current page is empty but the cursor is not empty, you must continue pagination
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。第一页不传；后续页原样传入上次响应的 NextToken，保持知识库、类型和页大小不变。游标为空表示结束；当前页为空但游标非空时仍应继续
parameters.name: next_token

Code.description_en: The business error code. This field is omitted if the request is successful. If the request fails, the common error response protocol applies
Code.description_zh: 业务错误代码。成功时可省略；失败遵循公共错误响应协议

Data.description_en: The summaries of the knowledge points on the current page and the cursor for the next page
Data.description_zh: 本页知识点摘要及下一页游标

KnowledgePoints.description_en: The summaries of the knowledge points that the current caller has permission to read on the current page. The KnowledgeBaseId, Type, and Id of each item can be directly used in GetKnowledgePoint
KnowledgePoints.description_zh: 本页当前调用者有权读取的知识点摘要。每项的 KnowledgeBaseId、Type 和 Id 可直接用于 GetKnowledgePoint

Id.description_en: The read identifier of the current knowledge point. For GRAPH, it is the entry node ID of the local graph. For WIKI, it is the page ID. For KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT, it is the content ID. Use this identifier as is in GetKnowledgePoint without parsing or concatenation
Id.description_zh: 当前知识点的读取标识。GRAPH 为局部图入口节点 ID，WIKI 为页面 ID，KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT 为内容 ID。原样用于 GetKnowledgePoint，不解析或拼接

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the knowledge point belongs. This ID is used together with Type and Id to locate the knowledge point
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 知识点所属的知识库 ID。与 Type、Id 一起定位知识点

Summary.description_en: The readable summary of the knowledge point. The summary is not guaranteed to contain the complete content. To obtain the details, call GetKnowledgePoint
Summary.description_zh: 知识点的可读摘要，不保证包含完整内容；需要详情时调用 GetKnowledgePoint
Summary.example: 销售额指标及其关联订单表。

Title.description_en: The readable title of the knowledge point. For GRAPH, the entry node name is used
Title.description_zh: 知识点的可阅读标题；GRAPH 使用入口节点名称

Type.description_en: The read category of the knowledge point. Valid values: GRAPH for local graph, WIKI for topic page, and KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT for knowledge content
Type.description_zh: 知识点读取类别：GRAPH 为局部图，WIKI 为主题页面，KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT 为知识内容

NextToken.description_en: The pagination cursor. Do not specify this parameter for the first page. For subsequent pages, pass the NextToken value from the previous response as is, and keep the knowledge base, type, and page size unchanged. An empty cursor indicates the end of the list. If the current page is empty but the cursor is not empty, you must continue pagination
NextToken.description_zh: 分页游标。第一页不传；后续页原样传入上次响应的 NextToken，保持知识库、类型和页大小不变。游标为空表示结束；当前页为空但游标非空时仍应继续

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of knowledge bases to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
MaxResults.description_zh: 每页最多返回的知识库数量，取值 1～100

Message.description_en: The readable description of the business error. This field is omitted if the request is successful. When troubleshooting a failure, provide the RequestId as well
Message.description_zh: 业务错误的可读说明，成功时可省略。失败定位时请同时提供 RequestId

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
